title: Next summer
goal: Talk about plans with the future and the present continuous: haftaya gidiyoruz, seneye göreceğiz.

intro.text: For an arrangement already made, use `-(I)yor`: *Haftaya Ankara'ya gidiyoruz* (We're going to Ankara next week). For an intention or a prediction, use `-(y)AcAk`: *Seneye Türkçe öğreneceğim*, *Galiba yağmur yağacak*. After a time phrase, *sonra* means **in**: *iki gün sonra*.

vocab.en: next (as in next week); the future

exercises.question: How do you say **next year**?
exercises.explain: *Seneye* means next year; so do *gelecek yıl* and *gelecek sene*.

exercises.en: The bus will leave in ten minutes.

exercises.prompt: We are going to Cappadocia next week.

reject.why: *Geçen hafta* is **last** week. Next week is *haftaya* or *gelecek hafta*.

accept: Maybe I will go to Canada next year.
Perhaps I [will go|am going|am going to go] to Canada next year.
Maybe I [am going|am going to go] to Canada next year.
I might go to Canada next year.
[Maybe|Perhaps] next year I will go to Canada.

exercises.en: This summer we're going on a balloon ride.

exercises.question: What has Murat already done?

context.en: What are you going to do this summer?
I'm going to Cappadocia. I've bought the tickets.

context.tr: Temmuzda. Balona bineceğim, çok fotoğraf çekeceğim.
context.en: In July. I'm going to go up in a balloon and take lots of photos.

context.tr: Gerçekten mi? Tamam, senin için de rezervasyon yapacağım.
context.en: Really? OK, I'll make a booking for you too.

exercises.explain: *Biletleri aldım* is in the past: done. The balloon, the photos and Selin's booking are still to come: *bineceğim*, *çekeceğim*, *yapacağım*.

exercises.text: Bak, hava çok bulutlu. Galiba yağmur ___.
exercises.en: Look, it's very cloudy. I think it's going to rain.
exercises.explain: A prediction from what you can see: the future, *yağacak*.

exercises.prompt: Maybe I will not come tomorrow.

accept: What are you doing this evening?
What are you going to do [this evening|tonight]?

exercises.label: *olmak* (to be, to become) in the future: I will be, you will be…
exercises.explain: The future of **to be** uses *olmak*: *Yarın evde olacağım* (I'll be at home tomorrow).

exercises.en: Next summer we're going to Turkey.

exercises.prompt: I will be at home this evening.

reject.why: `-(y)AcAk` goes on verbs only. **Will be** is *olacak*: *evde olacağım*.

exercises.explain: Front ö → *-ecek*; k → ğ before *-iz*: *göreceğiz*. *Göreceğiz* also means **we'll see**, when you'd rather not decide yet.

accept: The train will leave in half an hour.
The train [leaves|is leaving|departs|will depart] in half an hour.
The train will leave in thirty minutes.
